articles.title: Former Delhi Jal Board CEOs sent to two-day police custody in STP tender scam case
articles.description: Rouse Avenue court granted the ACB two days’ police custody of former DJB CEOs Udit Prakash Rai and Nagendra Yadav in the alleged STP tender scam case.
